SatQuery AI v0.3.0 • Deterministic-first agent • Offline-capable • About / Limitations
About & Limitations

What works: Deterministic agentic routing, input validation (GeoTIFF/TIFF/PNG/JPEG), single-image VQA/captioning/grounding (heuristic RS vision; LoRA swappable), change detection (LAB+Otsu+ morphology, real masks), optical/SAR analysis (NDVI/NDWI + backscatter stats), fusion (IoU/Dice agreement), confidence (heuristic, labeled), visual evidence, execution trace, JSON/PDF reports, 5 curated demos, invalid-input refusal.

Heuristic components: All confidence scores are heuristic (labeled as such). VQA/captioning uses classical CV + templates when LoRA checkpoint not loaded — not a hallucinating generic VLM. Change/optical/SAR are real CV pipelines.

LoRA adaptation: Training pipeline is implemented (training/train_lora.py); checkpoint is swappable. On 4GB VRAM the demo runs heuristic fallback — on 24GB cloud GPU, Qwen2-VL-2B QLoRA can be loaded. See docs/MODEL_CARD.md.

Known limitations: No real-time co-registration (assumes pre-registered pairs per PS). SAR detection is statistical; composites are penalized. Grouding boxes are heuristic, not detector-based. High-res Cartosat/RISAT generalization is untested without hidden data.

Next: Wire BLIP/Qwen2-VL checkpoint, replace grounding with Grounding-DINO, add tiling for sub-meter, integrate EarthMind as registry option.
